title: Rationale
html:
Rationale

China invades Taiwan by June 30, 2027

My figure for an invasion by mid-2027 is 2.5% against the market's 4.2%: the lower part of the range its price allows, weighted up from 1.5% because 2027 is the PLA's stated readiness year and Xi raised Taiwan directly with Trump this week. It moves in proportion with the market's odds.
